quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (annual report): operating revenue RMB 23,646,977,088.98, up 32.05% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 3,275,738,151.27, up 74.47%; net profit after non-recurring items RMB 3,113,627,500.81, up 78.96%. Quarterly revenue rose through the year: Q1 RMB 4,782,896,546.25, Q2 RMB 5,670,558,187.24, Q3 RMB 6,300,560,583.88, Q4 RMB 6,892,961,771.61 (Q4 net profit attributable RMB 949,912,599.65). The company attributed growth to AI compute upgrades, rising storage demand and vehicle electrification / intelligence.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Package substrate business in 2025: main-business revenue RMB 41.48 hundred million, up 30.80%, 17.54% of total revenue; gross margin 22.58%, up 4.43 percentage points; orders grew quickly as technical capability and product / customer introduction accelerated. BT substrates: memory-substrate capability advanced, bringing customers' high-end DRAM product projects into introduction and mass production and lifting related orders significantly; FC-CSP processor-substrate capability improved; RF substrates: new customers and products introduced, target products reached mass production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity: orders were saturated in 2025, creating internal capacity bottlenecks in some processes, so outsourced-processing costs rose 79.28% to RMB 821,997,041.51 (5.24% of electronic-circuit cost of sales). The PCB business faced phased output pressure and released capacity through technical retrofits that cleared bottlenecks plus digital and lean management; the Thailand plant and Nantong phase 4 were connected and started production in H2 2025, and the Guangzhou package substrate project phase 1 was still ramping at year end.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Raw materials in 2025 (annual report): sharp rises in gold and copper prices lifted copper foil and gold salt prices, which the company managed by negotiating with customers; upstream supply of key materials such as CCL glass-fibre cloth was tight and lead times for some copper-clad laminates lengthened substantially, which the company covered by stocking up and coordinating with suppliers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D in 2025: RMB 1,591,409,462.06, up 25.09%, 6.73% of revenue (none capitalised); 2,981 R&D staff. Projects cover next-generation communications and data-center PCB technology (next-generation server platforms, AI compute), FC-BGA substrate capability, FC-CSP fine-line and memory substrates, high-end RF substrates, semiconductor test boards and embedded integrated packaging. Backplane samples reach up to 120 layers and volume production 68 layers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Investment in 2025 was RMB 3,600,386,719.75, up 81.08%; construction in progress RMB 1,850,669,826.70 at year end. Major projects: Guangzhou Guangxin package substrate project - 73.88% of budget invested, ramping; high-order flip-chip IC substrate project - budget RMB 2,016,270,000.00, 84.29%, ramping but not yet in a full production year, so capacity and returns not fully released; Thailand high-speed high-density PCB project (Taixing Circuits, Thailand subsidiary) - budget RMB 1,274,180,000.00, 93.89%, ramping; next-generation smart mobile terminal, AI vision and spatial computing module PCB project - budget RMB 1,800,000,000.00, 63.25%, in construction and ramp.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 investment RMB 3,600,386,719.75 (+81.08%); Guangzhou substrate project 73.88% of budget invested

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company sees structural growth opportunities in its downstream markets in 2026 as leading technology companies keep raising compute-infrastructure capex, while trade tensions and geopolitical conflict remain risks. PCB will focus on strategic customers' core projects and accelerate line retrofits, new-plant capability and capacity ramp; package substrates will focus on strategic target customers and product introduction and accelerate FC-BGA capability; electronic assembly will expand in data center and industrial control. It flags that new PCB capacity across the industry may intensify competition.

quarterly_data.quarter: Shennan Circuits annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: PCB business in 2025: main-business revenue RMB 143.59 hundred million, up 36.84%, 60.73% of total revenue; gross margin 35.53%, up 3.91 percentage points. Data center: AI server and related product demand accelerated and orders rose significantly year on year, the key driver of PCB growth; communications: demand for high-speed switches and optical modules grew and orders rose substantially; automotive (ADAS and EV three-electric systems) orders kept growing fast.
